# Kate Kness

> Kate Kness is an Arizona-based strategist, author and digital builder. She writes, builds, and connects the dots: business strategy through Clarity Forward, the book Girl, Listen, and custom digital tools built for real people.

## Work
- [Clarity Forward](https://theclarityforward.com): operational strategy for business and nonprofit leaders, founded by Kate. Start with the free three-minute [Clarity Snapshot](https://snapshot.theclarityforward.com/).
- Custom digital tools, such as Clarity Connect, built around how an organization actually works.

## Books
- [Girl, Listen: Your Fascia Needs to Talk to You](https://katekness.com/book/) (Skye Press). The relationship between the body, emotions, and lived experience, told in fascia's own (slightly sassy) voice. ISBN 979-8-9954458-1-4 (paperback), 979-8-9954458-2-1 (hardcover). Available on Amazon, Barnes & Noble, and at Grove Coffee in Chandler, AZ.
